actual_observations: Rows a–c and d–f repeat the same logic for CD20/Ms4a1 and CD28/Cd28.
Scatter thresholds at foreground probabilities 0.2/0.8 and a protein-specific vertical GMM cutoff define four colored groups; intermediate probabilities remain gray.
The 2x2 UMAP displays and RNA histograms repeat those group colors, with all remaining cells gray.
Bottom panels g–j instead use a B-cell/T-cell legend; density axes are capped at 3.
visual_evidence.scope: Complete original figure, including all panels; crops are children, never counted as additional cases

scientific_task.question: Can a count-only threshold miss foreground/background structure that joint molecular profiles help resolve?
scientific_task.supported_claim: The selected cells and marker examples show distinct assignments and background-corrected distributions in SLN111-D1.
cannot_conclude: UMAP separation does not independently prove cell identity or mechanism.
The example panels do not establish universal denoising quality or clinical diagnostic sensitivity.

design_analysis.layout: Repeated three-column blocks carry selection, location and molecular context. Bottom pairs answer a different question: raw versus denoised distributions.
design_analysis.grouping: Color means quadrant in upper blocks and cell class in bottom blocks; explicit local legends are required.
design_analysis.axes: Foreground probability differs from expression intensity. Density differs from cell count; truncated y limits need disclosure.

transferable_rules: Use linked highlighting to follow identical units across plots, preserving a neutral background for unselected units.
When color semantics change between panel groups, supply local legends rather than relying on global color memory.
Pair observed and transformed distributions with explicit quantity names and any axis truncation.
Keep model-derived probability distinct from ground-truth label.
nontransferable_content: Marker identities, thresholds, quadrants and distributions do not transfer to other assays.
Cannot fabricate the underlying points or recreate densities from this image as exact published data.
limitations_and_ambiguities: Panel group correspondence is evidence-supporting, not an independent validation cohort.
No underlying count matrix downloaded; result reproduction remains untested.
